[SWS_DM_00202] Check for Supported RoutineIdentifier and Reaction
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall check, whether the RoutineIdentifier ad-
dressed by the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) is supported by an existing Di-
agnosticRoutine with a matching id in the configuration. If the RoutineIdentifier
addressed by the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) is not supported a negative re-
sponse with NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange) shall be returned.
⌋
